looks.caption: Step 5 key beside the approved image: mark low right in the sheet, stamp and flat cursor right of it, panel and letter tops on one line
The stamp's hit, 12 frames: large and high, the fall, contact with the page jump and lifted corners, one rebound frame, the hold
The lift toward the eye: the wet word uncovered, the arrow carried on the block's corner and set down right of it
Step 5 at rest: the wait panel, lower and taller, the counter's glare softened
